facts.text: I am looking to get new bike lights for my morning commutes.
My bike is a Trek Emonda SL 6.
I just got a new bike helmet, a Specialized Vice helmet in matte black.
I bought the Specialized Vice helmet at a discount from the local bike shop on Main Street today.
I am looking for bike lights around $40-$60.
I am considering the Cygolite Hotrod 50 bike light.
I am considering the Lezyne Strip Drive Pro bike light.
I want a USB-rechargeable bike light.
I decided to go with the Lezyne Strip Drive Pro bike light.
I have been practicing clipping in and out of my pedals at the local park on my lunch breaks.
I have been able to clip in and out without too much trouble.
I still feel awkward sometimes when clipping in and out.
I am not used to having my feet attached to the pedals.
I am hoping that with more practice, clipping in and out will become second nature.
I heard a new bike path is supposed to be built near the state park.
I heard the new bike path will be a 12-mile trail.
I heard the 12-mile trail is perfect for road bikes like my Trek Emonda SL 6.
I am thinking about getting a bike fit done for my Trek Emonda SL 6.
I am considering getting recommendations for bike fitters in the area.
I will do my research to find a reputable bike fitter in the area.
I have been enjoying my new Specialized Vice helmet.
I am glad I got the Specialized Vice helmet at a discount from the local bike shop on Main Street.
The Specialized Vice helmet has been a great addition to my biking gear.
